about: The prayer asks that the sacraments already received may nurture fervent charity in us. It recalls Robert’s continual self-giving for God’s Church, kindled by that same fervor.

seg.tr: Lord our God, may the sacraments we have received nurture in us the fervor of charity. Burning intensely with this fervor, blessed Robert continually spent himself for Your Church. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w009: The received sacraments, not Robert or the people, are the subject of this request to nurture charity’s fervor in us.
ex.w012: The antecedent is the fervor of charity. “By which” does not refer to the plural sacraments or to the Church.
ex.w016: Robert is described as kindled by that fervor. In the continuous prose, “burning intensely” expresses the resulting state, not an independently dated event.
ex.w022: The imperfect describes Robert’s sustained past self-giving. It is not a prediction and does not by itself identify a single death or martyrdom event.
ex.w039: “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
